text: Working with Git branching makes team collaboration much easier. When developers create feature branches, they can work on new features without affecting the main codebase. This keeps the project stable while changes are made. Once a feature is complete, the developer creates a pull request to propose merging their branch back into the main branch. Team members can then review the code, suggest improvements, and discuss changes before merging. This workflow is essential for version control, as it allows multiple people to contribute simultaneously while maintaining a clear history of changes and proper code quality standards.
